events.statement: A deployment of api-gateway version v9.3.0 was applied at 2026-03-10T08:00:00Z, upgrading the envoy filter chain and enabling HTTP/2 to upstreams.

Portfolio-service accesses three downstream components: ledger-db (shared PostgreSQL), market-data-service (HTTP), and redis-cache (shared Redis).
Both ledger-db and redis-cache are marked as shared resources used by multiple services.

events.title: Portfolio-service DB pool reduction caused connection starvation
Gateway HTTP/2 upgrade introduced resource pressure
Load balancer/network issue affecting portfolio traffic

events.summary: All four hypotheses rely on unverified assumptions or lack temporal alignment. H1 (DB pool reduction) is temporally inconsistent—the latency spike began before the config change, and there is no evidence of connection starvation. H2 (HTTP/2 upgrade) lacks any resource utilization data to confirm gateway pressure. H3 (ledger‑db overload) has no DB load metrics, and the shared‑resource claim is unverified. H4 (load‑balancer/network) has no change logs or latency measurements. Critical missing data include portfolio‑service DB pool usage, api‑gateway CPU/memory/connection metrics, and ledger‑db load metrics. Without these, we cannot confidently rank or accept any hypothesis.
